reply_text:
Found **one merge-blocking issue**:

**[P1] Only the first space is removed — `src/normalize.js:4`.**  
`replace(' ', '')` leaves subsequent spaces intact, so `queueText` rejects **all three examples in the README**, including `+1 (415) 555-0100`. Nothing is queued.

**Recommended fix:** remove spaces globally and add integration tests through `queueText` for the three documented examples. The existing normalization test (`test/normalize.test.js`, “a space, brackets and a dash go”) contains only one space, so it misses this.

All **5 existing tests pass**; I reproduced the failures separately. No code changes made.
